baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated negated volition at words 2 and 7 governs both provision at word 5 and feeding at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first object names an allotted resource; the second names another's act of feeding. Their parallel negation rejects both tribute transferred from creatures and creature-performed maintenance.

activation_trace.role: Contributes intending and willing, making the doubled clauses refusals of desire rather than reports of nonreceipt.
Contributes an allotted gift or share and supplies the resource-transfer side of the denied relation.
Contributes feeding another and supplies the denied service side of the relation.

changed_reading.before: The speaker merely says that he does not want food.
changed_reading.after: The double clause rejects both an allotted contribution and the act of being maintained by creature service.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Provision at word 5 is followed by the causative feeding action at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired terms span stored or assigned sustenance, its delivery, and its consumption. The denial therefore closes an entire nourishment chain rather than repeating one appetite in two synonyms.

activation_trace.role: Contributes ingestible sustenance and defines the material that would maintain a recipient.
Contributes tasting and consumption, marking the downstream end of the denied supply chain.
Contributes livelihood and good maintenance, broadening the denial beyond a single meal.

changed_reading.before: Provision and feeding restate the same food request.
changed_reading.after: Provision names the supply while feeding names its conversion into maintenance, and both stages are denied.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated volition root governs the action that the creatures would perform.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of volition involves pressing another toward an act against a competing will. Negating that relation rules out bargaining with or conscripting creatures into the role of feeders.

activation_trace.role: Contributes solicitation amid competing wills and exposes the social pressure explicitly negated here.
Contributes the act of feeding another as the service into which creatures are not being recruited.

changed_reading.before: No food is requested from them.
changed_reading.after: No pressure or negotiation recruits them into a provider role for the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation fixes the direction of dependence and worship fixes the creatures' responsive role; the immediate denial then prevents that service from being construed as replenishing or maintaining the creator.

activation_trace.role: Makes the two denials explicit refusals to desire maintenance from the addressed creatures.
Supplies the allotted contribution whose upward transfer is denied.
Supplies the creature-performed feeding service that is denied as worship's function.
Contributes origination of created beings and fixes the creator-to-creature direction of dependence.
Contributes submissive worship as the purpose-side relation that 51:57 strips of a provisioning function.

structural_cues: 51:56 states the created purpose immediately before the doubled first-person denial in 51:57.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, worship, provision, and feeding; I infer from their adjacency that the denial excludes a maintenance rationale for worship. A live alternative is that 51:57 rebuts only one imagined rationale without exhausting worship's purposes.

changed_reading.before: The speaker declines provision and feeding as isolated requests.
changed_reading.after: Worship is creature-side obedience, not a maintenance economy in which servants replenish their creator.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder immediately preceding the creation-purpose sequence is said to benefit believers, while the focus denies any resource or nourishment moving back from them. This relocates practical gain to the addressed recipients.

activation_trace.role: Contributes seeking and marks what the speaker does not pursue from the addressees.
Contributes the transferable benefit explicitly excluded from the speaker's side.
Contributes beneficiary-directed feeding and sharpens the denied return flow.
Contributes benefit rather than harm and locates positive effect on the reminder's recipients.

structural_cues: 51:55 grammatically assigns benefit to believers, and 51:56-57 follows without a change in exhortative setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recipient benefit followed by denied return provision; I infer a directional contrast in which the summons serves the hearers rather than enriching the speaker. Alternatively, the benefit may belong narrowly to reminder uptake, not to the whole worship relation.

changed_reading.before: The denial only establishes that the speaker takes no food payment.
changed_reading.after: The denial helps identify the addressees, not the speaker, as beneficiaries of the summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah identifies the divine side as the active source of allotment and pairs that role with gathered strength and enduring solidity. The focus denial becomes a categorical reversal of economic direction, not modest refusal.

activation_trace.role: Marks the allotted transfer that cannot originate with the creatures toward the speaker.
Marks the feeding service whose direction is likewise rejected.
Places allotment on the divine provider side and reverses the direction imagined in 51:57.
Contributes strength gathered like load-bearing strands and grounds nondependence on creature supply.
Contributes extended solidity and stabilizes the provider role against any need for replenishment.

structural_cues: 51:58 immediately answers the two denials by identifying the provider and appending capacity predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provider, strength, and solidity; I infer that these predicates explain why provision flows outward and never maintains the provider. They may alternatively guarantee reliable provision without directly defining nonneed.

changed_reading.before: A powerful speaker happens not to request food.
changed_reading.after: Creatures cannot provision or feed this speaker because provision originates from the self-sufficient provider.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the next two ayat, the denied upward allotment is followed by divine provisioning and then a matched portion assigned to wrongdoers. The focus becomes the hinge of a one-way distributive order: creatures do not supply God, while creatures receive both sustenance and consequence.

activation_trace.role: Contributes an allotted share and establishes the upward transfer that the focus denies.
Reassigns allotment to the divine source in the first step of the directional reversal.
Contributes a portion or lot and turns distributive language toward what wrongdoers receive.
Contributes equivalence and makes the consequential portion correspond to that of earlier companions.

structural_cues: The local order is denied receipt in 51:57, provider identification in 51:58, and an equivalent portion in 51:59.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two allotment-capable roots and explicit equivalence; I infer a shared distributive mechanism whose direction changes at the focus. The alternative is a local lexical echo rather than one continuous economic model.

changed_reading.before: The denial concerns only the absence of tribute.
changed_reading.after: The denial marks a distributive reversal: no share rises to God, while apportioned provision and consequence descend to creatures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the focus root's secondary split-root inventory rather than the ordinary volition sense. It remains packet-anchored at the repeated focus root and gains a coherent mechanism from the following strength and firmness cues; downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant echo, not as the clause's lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated root at words 2 and 7 also resolves to a branch involving a support that prevents collapse.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a load-bearing prop and recasts denied creature provision as refusal of external support.
Contributes internally gathered strength that makes an outside prop unnecessary.
Contributes stability in place and completes the image of standing without creature support.

changed_reading.before: The speaker does not seek edible maintenance.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary material register, the speaker needs no creature as a prop that keeps him standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The full-measure image is more material than the ordinary consequential reading and therefore surprising. It remains valid as a branch-backed resonance between focus provision and the repeated word in 51:59; render it as an imagistic reversal of flow, not as proof that the two roots are synonyms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The allotted provision at word 5 can be compared with the repeated consequential measure two ayat later.

activation_trace.role: Contributes an allotted share whose movement from creatures toward the speaker is denied.
Places the act of allotting on the divine side before the material image turns toward recipients.
Contributes a filled bucket or full measure and materializes the consequence assigned downward.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply refuses a contribution from creatures.
changed_reading.after: The refused upward supply is followed by a full downward measure, making the focus a reversal point in the direction of filling.

strongest_changes: 51:56 turns the denial into a guardrail: worship is obedience, not provisioning the creator.
51:58 converts modest refusal into provider-side asymmetry grounded in strength and firmness.
51:59 extends the allotment register from denied upward tribute to matched downward consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled focus negation closes both the resource and service channels; the split-root support image and the later full-measure branch preserve material readings that a conservative synthesis could lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The beneficiary-direction reading depends on discourse adjacency and may apply more narrowly to reminder uptake.
The supporting-prop activation is deliberately form-distant and should remain secondary.
The allotment echo in 51:59 may be rhetorical juxtaposition rather than a unified distributive mechanism.
